tools.name: make_pattern_from_image
tools.description: Converts a public PNG, JPEG or WebP image into a punch needle pattern with the website's pattern converter. Returns the pattern as a stitch grid preview, its colours and the yarn each colour needs in a fine-wool kit and a rug-wool kit.

tools.name: find_patterns
tools.description: Lists the original punch needle patterns in the Punchneedle.ai library, filtered by theme and level. Each pattern shows its finished size, number of colours, level and preview image.

tools.name: get_pattern
tools.description: Returns one library pattern with its size, colours, making steps, materials and the yarn each colour needs in a fine-wool kit and a rug-wool kit.

tools.name: calculate_yarn
tools.description: Estimates the yarn for a punch needle design from its size, the share of each colour and the needle and loop height, or from a measured swatch. Returns metres, grams and whole skeins for each colour.

tools.name: resize_pattern
tools.description: Rescales a library pattern, or a design of a given size, to a new width or height with the proportions kept. Returns the new dimensions, the number of printed A4 and US Letter sheets and, for a library pattern, the yarn at the new size.

tools.name: match_materials
tools.description: Checks whether a punch needle, a fabric and a yarn work together, using the website's material guidance. Returns the verdict for each part, what to change and the checks to make on a swatch.

tools.name: get_material_guide
tools.description: Returns the website's guide to one punch needle material: needles, needle sizes, fabric, monk's cloth, yarn, floss, hoops or glue. The guide holds its sections, tables and related pages.
